warning.titlePre: Mercedes V200 Injector Seal & Timing Chain Wear
paragraphs: If your V200 is an early W447-generation model with the OM651 engine — broadly the period before the 2025 refresh — injector seal leaks and timing chain wear are a recognised specialist pattern on this engine. We replace injector seals, timing chain components, tensioners and gaskets as standard on every OM651 rebuild.

The W638 generation uses different engines (OM601/OM602), and the current 2025-refresh W447 models use the newer OM654 engine — neither of which shares this specific pattern. The OM654 is a separate, more recent diesel family with its own characteristics, but nothing as consistently documented as the OM651's pattern in this application.
warning.source: Source: established specialist pattern per VRF-mercedes-v-class.md. W638 (OM601/OM602) and current OM654 explicitly excluded from this claim per VRF, correctly scoped to generation and engine code
